Greek Capital Letter Gamma Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Greek Capital Letter Gamma is 226. Hold Alt, type 226 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Greek Capital Letter Gamma also has the Unicode codepoint U+0393, so you can type it with Alt+915 on Windows, search for U+0393 in macOS's Character Viewer, use Γ in HTML, or \0393 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Greek Capital Letter Gamma character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity Γ for Greek Capital Letter Gamma, but the numeric form Γ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type greek capital letter gamma on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 2 2 6 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Greek Capital Letter Gamma character (Γ) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type greek capital letter gamma on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Greek Capital Letter Gamma. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Greek Capital Letter Gamma" and click the character to insert it.

How to use greek capital letter gamma in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\0393"; ()
  • Python: \u0393 or chr(0x393)
  • JavaScript: \u0393 or String.fromCodePoint(0x393)
  • JSON: "\u0393"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Greek Capital Letter Gamma?

The legacy Alt code for Greek Capital Letter Gamma is 226. Hold Alt, type 2 2 6 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type Γ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as Γ, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+915 not work?

Alt+915 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Greek Capital Letter Gamma?

The Unicode codepoint for Greek Capital Letter Gamma is U+0393. You can use this value in HTML as Γ, in CSS as \0393, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type Γ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+0393, then click it.
